Enterprise Brand Audit • Openink Hub

A complete Enterprise Brand Audit — beyond SEO, across every channel that drives visibility.

Search has split into four disciplines at once — SEO, AEO, GEO, and AIO — while your website, local presence, and social channels keep generating data most businesses never fully read. Our Enterprise Brand Audit brings it all into one report: technical health, content performance, AI visibility, and brand reputation, so you know exactly where you stand and exactly what to fix first.

Quick answer: An Enterprise Brand Audit reviews how a business performs across SEO, AEO, GEO and AIO, plus its website, local presence and social channels. Openink Hub brings technical health, search visibility and AI visibility into one report with a prioritized action plan, so you know what to fix first.

Why now

Search changed. Most brand audits didn't.

Customers no longer find you in one place. If your audit only checks Google rankings, it's already missing where your next customer actually is.

  • AI answer engines like ChatGPT and Gemini now influence buying decisions before Google does
  • Core Web Vitals and page speed directly affect both rankings and conversion rates
  • EEAT signals now decide whether AI and search engines trust your brand at all
  • Local competitors are winning nearby customers through optimized GMB profiles
  • Most businesses collect GSC, GA4, and GTM data but never act on it
  • Disconnected reports mean issues get caught months after they've already cost you leads

How it works

From raw data to a prioritized action plan

01

We securely link Google Search Console, GA4, GTM, Bing Webmaster Tools, your website, GMB profile, and social channels.

02

Run the 132-point audit

Our framework scans technical SEO, on-page SEO, local SEO, AEO, GEO, AIO, Core Web Vitals, page speed, EEAT, and more.

03

Benchmark your Brand DNA

We map your brand's current positioning, voice, and visibility footprint across search and AI answer engines.

04

Deliver a prioritized report

You receive a single, easy-to-read report with an executive summary and a clear, prioritized action plan — not just raw numbers.

Frequently Asked Questions About the Enterprise Brand Audit

What is a brand audit?

A brand audit is a comprehensive evaluation of a company's online and offline presence. It assesses brand identity, website performance, search visibility, customer perception, competitor positioning, and marketing effectiveness to identify strengths and opportunities for improvement.

Why is a brand audit important?

A brand audit helps businesses understand how customers perceive their brand, uncover gaps in their marketing strategy, improve brand consistency, strengthen online visibility, and make data-driven decisions for long-term growth.

What does a brand audit include?

A typical brand audit includes an analysis of brand messaging, website performance, SEO, social media presence, online reviews, content quality, competitor benchmarking, visual identity, and customer experience.

How often should a business conduct a brand audit?

Most experts recommend conducting a brand audit at least once a year or whenever there is a major business change, such as a rebrand, website redesign, product launch, or significant shift in marketing strategy.

Can a brand audit improve SEO and online visibility?

Yes. A brand audit identifies technical SEO issues, content gaps, keyword opportunities, inconsistent branding, and user experience problems that can impact search rankings and overall online visibility.

What are the signs that a business needs a brand audit?

Common signs include declining website traffic, lower search rankings, inconsistent branding across channels, reduced customer engagement, negative online reviews, falling conversion rates, or increased competition in the market.
